records.trace:
```python
def decimal_to_binary(n):
    if n == 0:
        return "0"
    negative = n < 0
    n = abs(n)
    digits = []
    while n > 0:
        digits.append(str(n % 2))
        n //= 2
    binary_str = ''.join(reversed(digits))
    if negative:
        binary_str = '-' + binary_str
    return binary_str
```

def count_inversions(arr):
    def merge_sort(sequence):
        if len(sequence) <= 1:
            return sequence, 0

        mid = len(sequence) // 2
        left, left_count = merge_sort(sequence[:mid])
        right, right_count = merge_sort(sequence[mid:])

        merged = []
        i = j = 0
        inversions = left_count + right_count

        while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
            if left[i] <= right[j]:
                merged.append(left[i])
                i += 1
            else:
                merged.append(right[j])
                j += 1
                inversions += len(left) - i

        merged.extend(left[i:])
        merged.extend(right[j:])

        return merged, inversions

    _, total_inversions = merge_sort(list(arr))
    return total_inversions

def count_inversions(arr):
    def merge_sort(sequence):
        if len(sequence) <= 1:
            return sequence, 0

        mid = len(sequence) // 2
        left, left_count = merge_sort(sequence[:mid])
        right, right_count = merge_sort(sequence[mid:])

        merged = []
        i = j = 0
        inversions = left_count + right_count

        while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
            if left[i] <= right[j]:
                merged.append(left[i])
                i += 1
            else:
                merged.append(right[j])
                j += 1
                inversions += len(left) - i

        merged.extend(left[i:])
        merged.extend(right[j:])

        return merged, inversions

    _, total_inversions = merge_sort(list(arr))
    return total_inversions
